body_markdown:
Mercury retrograde has plans for your plans, so give thanks for one thing you can control: your fragrance choice. Go ahead and feast your senses on November’s scent matches.


## Aries:[Imaginary Authors A Whiff of Waffle Cone](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/imaginary-authors-a-whiff-of-waffle-cone-14309954369116)


Your holiday itinerary is getting stuffed faster than the turkey, just how you like it. Speaking of stuffing, leave it to an Aries to arrive at Thanksgiving smelling like an entire dessert buffet. Vanilla, salted caramel, and cinnamon mix means someone’s getting a second helping of A Whiff of Waffle Cone.


## Taurus:[Catherine Malandrino Unconquered](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/catherine-malandrino-unconquered-2443)


Make room at the table, Taurus, because someone new might be joining your inner circle. Whether they’ll conquer your notoriously selective heart remains to be seen, but Unconquered, with its juicy mandarin and creamy coconut milk, is making a rather persuasive first impression.


## Gemini:[Juliette Has A Gun Purple Trouble](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/juliette-has-a-gun-purple-trouble-13969216102982)


Mercury retrograde is serving workplace beef, and for once, Gemini, you didn’t order it. But Purple Trouble? Oh, that’s absolutely your order. Sweet wild blackberry with a spicy kick of red chili pepper sounds suspiciously like the two sides of your personality having a very interesting conversation.


## Cancer:[Commodity Spice Personal](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/commodity-spice-personal-115425767309967)


Some families guard their Thanksgiving recipes like state secrets. Cancer guards their feelings with exactly 100% the same determination. A little Spice Personal, all saffron, allspice, and cinnamon sugar, should help make the whole affair a touch sweeter.


## Leo:[SRHY 69. Road Trip](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/srhy-69.-road-trip-225097946790467)


It’s Friendsgiving season, and naturally, Leo, you’re on everyone’s list of giving thanks simply for your existence. The question is how many celebrations can one Lion attend before the month is over? We’ll go ahead and answer it with a lot. With 69. Road Trip riding shotgun, you’ll have orange, muguet, and pine keeping you company between parties.


## Virgo:[Victoria’s Secret Bare Sueded Vanilla](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/victoria-s-secret-bare-sueded-vanilla-267904168148129)


Thanksgiving may be the only November plan Mercury doesn’t make you reschedule, which means that meticulously organized dinner of yours is actually happening. Bare Sueded Vanilla is your well-deserved soft landing after all that Virgo-level preparation. The suede-like warmth and vanilla milk are a standing invitation to put your feet up and queue up the holiday season in a relaxing manner.


## Libra:[IGGYWOO Pistachio Voodoo Child](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/iggywoo-pistachio-voodoo-child-27609766198025)


Enjoy the feast, Libra, but maybe don’t let Black Friday eat your entire paycheck. Make an exception for a fragrance called Pistachio Voodoo Child that comes along recommended by the stars and puts a spell on your shopping cart. It’s a pistachio and jasmine mix, so…Resistance was never your strongest suit, was it?


## Scorpio:[The Twilight Saga x Scentbird New Moon](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/twilight-x-scentbird-new-moon-3459762932549)


Give thanks for boundaries, Scorpio. They pair beautifully with pie and unanswered questions. Nobody understands complicated relationships better than the inhabitants of Forks, Washington, so we know why the stars chose this perfume.[New Moon](https://www.scentbird.com/blog/new-moon-twilight/) brings ginger flower, caramel, and glowing amber to your mysterious little Thanksgiving gathering. Edward Cullen would approve of the brooding.


## Sagittarius:[Storie Veneziane by Valmont Rosa Fucsia](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/storie-veneziane-by-valmont-rosa-fucsia-i-261620089584300)


Before birthday season gets stuffed with plans, treat November like dessert: slow down and savor it. Listen Sag, that means actually stopping to smell the roses. Rosa Fucsia offers rose-led floral with enough Italian charm to satisfy your wanderlust without another airport security line.


## Capricorn:[Merit Retrospect](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/merit-retrospect-66115596198079)


This month is busy enough, so let Thanksgiving be the gathering you don’t need to manage. In Retrospect, agreeing to organize everything from the seating arrangements to the Secret Santa wasn’t your brightest idea. At least your fragrance choice is sorted, with this perfect amber floral pick making one less thing to cross off that endless to-do list.


## Aquarius:[Lake & Skye 11 11](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/lake-skye-11-11-37521745796504)


It’s the eleventh month, you’re wearing 11 11, and the clock just struck 11:11. An Aquarius would never insult the universe by calling it a coincidence. Don’t question anything, least the universe, so just make a wish and let the airy musk and woods work their magic.


## Pisces:[By Rosie Jane Rosie](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/by-rosie-jane-rosie-4894)


Mercury may wreck the itinerary, so make home good enough to cancel Thanksgiving travel anyway. A little Rosie, with all its soft rose, white musk, and white amber, should do nicely.


## Give Thanks, Pass the Perfume


If the stars nail your[November fragrance match](https://www.scentbird.com/) , it’s wonderful. If not, we dare say it’s even better, because now you’ve got something to bring to Friendsgiving that isn’t another bottle of wine.
